$comment: FIXTURE (scripts/test-starter-apps*.mjs): the library a research pack would ship beside its specialists. Its starter apps are generated by the pack's own specialist (scripts/fixtures/app-source/, stamped in as agent/subagents/ledger-reader/) and by this library's own workflow. Three shapes: a specialist with a schedule, a workflow refreshed on request, and one whose first document is written when the workspace is created.
